translation_interpretation: Translation alignment removes about 89% of the VAL and 91% of the consumed-SEALED absolute Official-to-E1 gain. A smaller aligned gain remains, so the evidence supports translation-dominant mixed improvement rather than translation-only improvement.

train_only_constant_translation_baseline.interpretation: The simple calibration absorbs about 65%/74% of the absolute E1 gain, but remains 10.43/8.10 mm worse than E1.

surface_loss.sampling: 2048 observations and 4096 face-index-uniform triangle samples; epoch-varying seed
surface_loss.area_weighted_decision: No automatic replacement: slightly lower floor, no material perturbed-gradient stability gain in the controlled test.

loss_component_gradients: At E1, surface gradients conflict locally with Official teacher 2D/3D on all three probed DEV frames (cosines about -0.27 and -0.49); this alone does not justify deleting teacher losses.
sensor_claim_limit: Descriptive cross-view nearest-neighbour consistency; not a true sensor error floor and not subtractable from model error.
required_before_next_training: Fix/evaluate the stochastic surface-loss measurement contract and require the TRAIN-only translation calibration as a formal baseline.
